info.name: AQDAR API
info.description:
AQDAR Egypt marketplace REST API (`/api/v1`).

Import `AQDAR-Local.postman_environment.json`, select **AQDAR Local**, then run **Phase 1 — Identity → Register** or **Verify OTP**. `auth_token` is stored automatically.

After each finished phase, add a folder `Phase N — …` with every new route. See docs/DOCUMENTATION_PROCESS.md and docs/API.md.

**Shipped:** Phase 0–9 (identity through admin reports/settings/audit/hardening).
Staff dashboard is Blade (session), not this collection. ADM-10…14 are not in this collection.

item.name: Phase 9 — Handover
item.description: UAT-20 smoke: /up, /config (platform_name + maintenance). Listings search is throttled 30/min. Maintenance 503s marketplace API except GET /config. Staff ADM-01/12/13/14 are Blade.

item.name: Phase 13 — Listing fields
item.description: No new marketplace routes. Specs: phase, parking, unit_code (never public). Financials: offer_expires_at, installment paid + evidence_document_id (same listing). Category step copies commission_policy_code (not a payout). Public GET /categories omits the policy code. Staff assign-reviewer is Blade ADM-02.

request.description: Owner + staff see unit_code. Public listing JSON never includes it.

item.name: Phase 14 — Cases
item.description: GET /my/cases is buyer or seller. Client-safe labels only. lifecycle = open|waiting_for_information|on_hold|cancelled|lost|completed. Staff lifecycle history is Blade ADM-09.

request.description: No internal_stage, buyer, or seller objects. status is the client stage label.
timeline[].at is the recorded milestone. viewer is buyer|seller. lifecycle is the alternative status. No counterparty PII.

item.description: GET /notifications may include listing_held and listing_suspended. Staff queue events are Blade /dashboard/inbox only — never marketplace inbox, never push.
